title: 47 Years Later, This Remains The Most Addictive Sci-Fi Franchise of All Time
summary: Alien became one of the most iconic horror franchises with the creation of the terrifying apex predator, the xenomorph.
content: In this day and age, franchise films have overwhelmed the cultural landscape, but one still finds a way to reinvent itself. This IP continues to impress, even decades after it came screaming out of the darkness. Sci-fi horror was in its early days in the ‘70s, but Ridley Scott ’s Alien redefined what it meant to be scared.

title: 34 Years Later, Clint Eastwood's Best Quote Is Still the Greatest in Western Movie History
summary: In his 1992 Western masterpiece Unforgiven, Clint Eastwood's best quote weighed in not just on the film's plot, but on the heart of Western cinema.
content: For many who grew up in the 1990s, Unforgiven was the definitive Western . It somehow smelled of whiskey, gunsmoke, and a father's aftershave, and remained a monolithic genre presence for years to come — that's how praised it was and how ubiquitous it became on network television after its release. While director, producer, composer, and star Clint Eastwood actually waffled on making the film for years, once he did, he defined the modern revisionist Western and reminded audiences of his incredible talent, while looking back at his career with clear eyes.

title: 23 Years Later, Billy Bob Thornton’s Holiday Crime Masterpiece Is Officially a Streaming Hit
summary: Billy Bob Thornton's 2003 heist movie Bad Santa, now one of the most-streamed films on Paramount+, is one of the best black comedies of the 2000s.
content: "Is [insert film] a Christmas movie?" is a long-running (and perhaps somewhat tiresome) debate in our modern culture. This question often applies to dark, gritty, and R-rated movies that just happen to take place during the holiday season, but share little resemblance to the magic and wonder of Miracle on 34th Street , i.e. the preeminent target of this debate, Die Hard . But for the Christmas movie purists, the hardest to embrace might be a film that unquestionably fits the bill for the genre: Bad Santa .

title: 7 Dystopian Books To Read if You Love 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping'
summary: From The Long Walk to Never Let Me Go, these dystopian books are perfect to read if you love The Hunger Games prequel Sunrise on the Reaping.
content: Dystopias are back. The genre that took over an entire generation of young readers in the early 2010s is making a return , with the premiere of the movie adaptation of Suzanne Collins ' Sunrise on the Reaping , the second prequel novel to The Hunger Games franchise, as well as the release of The Sixth Faction , a new alternate-universe book in Veronica Roth 's Divergent series. These stories are entertaining adventures that follow a hero's journey, but they also include political commentary about propaganda and authoritarian states.

title: Jon Bernthal’s 132-Minute Crime Thriller 'The Accountant 2' Is the Perfect Watch Before It’s Cut From Hulu
summary: Jon Bernthal and Ben Affleck team up to play brothers in action thriller The Accountant 2, which will only be available on Hulu through Nov 3.
content: It can’t always be award-winning dramas and true-crime documentaries when you’re watching movies at home. Sometimes, you want an entertaining, bullet-riddled rollercoaster, and there are few that fit the bill better than 2025’s The Accountant 2 . In the long-awaited sequel to the 2016 original, Ben Affleck returns as Christian Wolff, a neurodivergent accountant and trained killer who comes out of hiding to solve a case involving the death of an old friend, which forces him to reunite with his estranged brother, played by Jon Bernthal . The pair make for a unique buddy movie pairing, filled with action and withering put-downs that made the movie a hit with audiences. With the film leaving Hulu on December 1, your last chance to watch it streaming is November 30.

title: Before The Lord of the Rings, Tolkien Wrote an Epic Christmas Saga for His Kids
summary: Long before he revolutionized fantasy with The Lord of the Rings, J.R.R. Tolkien wrote a series of epic Christmas-themed stories for his children.
content: When J.R.R. Tolkien first comes to mind, Middle-earth soon follows. The literary genius who crafted The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings is easily best known for his medieval-inspired work of high fantasy that wove everything from his personal experience during the Great War to his devoted Christian faith into one cohesive mythological tapestry.

title: The 6 Most Bingeable Crime Shows You Can Finish In a Weekend
summary: From Broadchurch to The Night Of, these crime shows are perfect for a weekend in.
content: Sometimes we seek out something with a darker tone and narrative as a means of escape. It’s why crime shows continue to be a go-to genre for television fans. The genre offers viewers a chance to dive into a gritty underworld and watch crime unfold before their eyes. Whether it be a murder mystery of a syndicate of unsavory individuals, the stories crime shows get to tell keep us glued to our screens. If you’re seeking out a crime drama and only have a single weekend to watch, we’ve got six shows perfect for you!

title: Netflix’s Most Unhinged 2-Season Crime Thriller Plays Like ‘Ozark’ in a Temple
summary: Netflix’s The Believers is a two-season Thai crime thriller for Ozark fans, with a temple scam that escalates into a money-laundering scheme.
content: Starting in 2017, Netflix struck gold with its original crime drama series Ozark . Led by powerhouse performers Jason Bateman and Laura Linney , the series follows a Chicago financial planner, Marty, as he gets wrapped in a money-laundering scheme for a Mexican cartel, and soon unravels his life, his family, and his own morals. The series, which went on to win four Primetime Emmys, reached an end in 2022 with its fourth and final season. But, in case Ozark fans are looking for a new show to tap into , the Thai Netflix crime series The Believers could finally fill the void.

title: 10 Years Later, Netflix's Greatest Sci-Fi Masterpiece Has Officially Racked Up 1.4B Streaming Hours
summary: Stranger Things remains a beloved Netflix hit 10 years later, with 1.4 billion hours watched since its 2016 premiere.
content: Netflix's catalog is full of memorable shows, but even after 10 years, one series still stands above the rest. Stranger Things kicked off a massive franchise for the streamer, delivering terrifying mysteries, lovable characters, and a heavy dose of nostalgia. Since its 2016 premiere, the sci-fi show has become one of Netflix's most recognizable properties. Although the series finale aired at the end of last year, Stranger Things has continued to draw an audience throughout 2026, with fans watching more than 1.4 billion hours , and it's easy to see why.

title: Netflix’s 10/10 ‘House of Cards’ Replacement Is Officially Taking Over the World
summary: Netflix's hit political thriller remains a streaming sensation. Get more details here.
content: Competition has always been high on Netflix because the streamer is dedicated to keeping its global subscriber base engaged. With an output like no other, Netflix debuts new shows weekly and occasionally lands a hit series. Currently, viewers are enjoying a recent hit series about Catholic girls who start exhibiting weird group psychosis. The series The Body is dominating streaming charts globally and is currently ranked the number one show. However, while some shows might be immediate hits, others slowly build up their viewership as fans catch up and keep them in the top ten.
